fairness: hold-out seeds disjoint from training seeds 1-4 by construction; every hold-out row is a fresh flight on current HEAD under joint-mode semantics with the standard declared actuator; chance specs rebuilt from the bands flown

paired_baseline.note: a rejection whose paired baseline world LANDED is a measured constraint cost (the chance model refused a world that would have flown); one whose baseline also failed is a rejection that agreed with an independent grading

diagnosis_verdict.reading: the 59% rejections are physical, not probabilistic: 51/99 bind on the corridor-divert budget and 48 on the fuel quantile; NOT ONE rejection is bound by the landing-probability channel (the p_land term never decides alone, so a mis-calibrated p_land is not what makes the arm infeasible). The dispersion-band meeting the spec (deep violations) is the majority (51/99), planner-search-rescuable near-threshold rejections the minority (18); and 20/99 rejections are worlds the FL-305 grading DID land -- the measured constraint cost of the joint spec on the training grid.

cluster_reanalysis.method_note: E7-03's headline pooled the three fit arms into ONE 409-row 2x2 (Fisher p = 0.0104) on rows that share four seeds and the same draw grid. Here each seed is one stratum with the fit arms' rows summed inside it (the seed is the sampling unit), tested with Mantel-Haenszel, exact per-seed Fisher combined, and a whole-cluster bootstrap CI; the per-arm MH p-values then form the Holm family.

per_seed_stratified.method: Mantel-Haenszel (continuity corrected) + Fisher-combined exact per-cluster p + whole-cluster bootstrap phi; clusters are the resampling unit

mantel_haenszel.note: continuity correction -0.5 on the pooled numerator; df = 1, tail exact via erfc

pooled_naive_phi.warning: pools cluster-correlated rows as iid -- optimistic

per_seed_stratified.note: pooled_naive_phi is the E7-03-style pooled reading kept for the comparison only; its significance is the MH / combined-exact numbers, not the pooled 2x2 Fisher
